catalog: LedgerLock P5 falsifiability corpus (C2-P5 correction): one controlled mutation per retained PLAN-V2.2 ProductProofSpec, applied to the frozen WP-2.0.3 reference (tests/v2/fixtures/workloads/ledgerlock-reference/reference, never modified). A change names a reference module and a line occurring exactly once in it; `after` replaces it (a list of lines; null deletes it); `remove` deletes the module; `rename_to` moves it. `modules` binds, per materialised tree, the sha256 of every module that differs from the reference (null when absent): the corpus is content-addressed and a materialisation that does not reproduce these digests is refused. Independent of the P0 mutants (P0-REFERENCE-FIXTURE.json), which prove the reference acceptance falsifiable, not these specs.

a batch replaces the ledger with its own lines: committed lines are lost
a batch writes its lines before the committed ones: an existing record is rewritten out of place
the op field is stored as PUT / DELETE
the value field is stored as a JSON string, not as the JSON value
the ts field is stored as a string, not an integer

the ledger's last line is left without its terminating newline
the value is not part of the hashed bytes: a mutated value is not detected
the op is not part of the hashed bytes: a swapped op is not detected
verify does not recompute hashes: a modified hash on the last line is not detected
verify does not check that prev_hash is the previous line's hash
